jobs.label: MIRV reentry warhead
jobs.description: One small dark graphite conical reentry warhead exterior, 145px long, sharp nose NORTH with a softly glowing amber heat rim, slightly rounded broad base SOUTH. NO rocket fins, no booster engine. Short restrained wispy orange heated-air wake SOUTH in four flicker poses. Whole cone axis lies north-south in image plane; look straight down, no end-on circular bomb. Generic fictional game warhead, no internal diagram.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Top-down RTS projectile animation for Age of Fronts Modern Age, matching the weathered olive-steel realistic hand-painted style of the supplied reference. Reference is style only, replace its subject. A precise 2x2 atlas, 1254x1254 RGBA, FOUR 627x627 cells read row-major, ONE SAME projectile per cell with its nose pointing screen NORTH/top and tail SOUTH/bottom. Exact 90-degree vertical orthographic camera; longitudinal body lies in image plane. Identical sharp rigid body coordinates and scale across all four cells; only restrained tail exhaust/tracer flicker changes. Exterior game prop, no cutaway or technical labels, text, flags, background, clouds or target. Transparent alpha and at least 65px clear margin in each cell. One small dark graphite conical reentry warhead exterior, 145px long, sharp nose NORTH with a softly glowing amber heat rim, slightly rounded broad base SOUTH. NO rocket fins, no booster engine. Short restrained wispy orange heated-air wake SOUTH in four flicker poses. Whole cone axis lies north-south in image plane; look straight down, no end-on circular bomb.
